messages:
Iris Gomez: started FP8-E sweep on rah-14b-candidate focused on punctuation-sensitive outputs (CSV/JSON/markdown tables). Quick summary: normal perplexities but punctuation token probs down, leading to delimiter loss and occasional hallucinated extra key names in JSON. Link to artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/quant-bakeoffs/fp8e-punct/1767234012

Hector Alvarez: paste minimal repro pls

Iris Gomez: repro prompt:
```
You are a JSON API. Return only JSON with keys ["summary","references"].
Text: "Agreement: party A liable up to $1,000,000; contact: legal@example.com"
```

Iris Gomez: baseline (fp16/gptq) output:
```
{"summary":"Limits vendor’s tort liability to commercial damages.","references":["https://contracts.internal/agr/222"]}
```

Iris Gomez: FP8-E output:
```
{summary: "Limits liability and money.", references: ["see contract"], note: "check legal"}
```

Kai Wong: that's both a formatting regression (missing quotes) and a hallucinated `note` field. Also looks like comma token probs are reduced.

Rina Patel: do we have token-level diffs for `"` and `,` and whitespace?

Iris Gomez: attaching token-diff csv in artifacts. Early look: comma token prob dropped ~40% median at schema boundaries; quote token prob also reduced. Space tokens sometimes merged into preceding tokens.

eval-bot: batch run 1767233900 metrics: schema-exact -10.5%, json-fidelity -6.8% absolute, hallucination +5.1pp. Failures concentrated in short-field structured outputs.

Hector Alvarez: which quant path + hw?

Iris Gomez: AWQ-FP8-E kernel on A100 + replicated on T4 emulation. No fallback triggered.

Kai Wong: possible culprits: softmax scaling/clipping for low-entropy ascii tokens under FP8, or post-quant embedding/tokenizer mismatch. Also check fused kernel implementations that treat small token ids differently.

Iris Gomez: repro script: ./run_struct_bakeoff.sh --model rah-14b-cand --quant awq-fp8e --suite structured-short --seed 3

Hector Alvarez: quick mitigations:
- route structured outputs to fp16 in deployment profile
- add post-parse validator that rejects malformed JSON and falls back
- add token-probe in preprocessor to nudge comma/quote tokens (ugly but fast)

Rina Patel: I'll add a canary profile with fp16 preference for content-type:application/json

Iris Gomez: created ticket RED-ml-9012 with reproducer + artifacts (https://issues.internal/RED-ml/9012) and assigned Kai + Rina

Kai Wong: I'll run isolated kernel comparisons and disable stochastic rounding on FP8 to see delta. ETA 48h.

Iris Gomez: action items pinned:
- Iris: minimal repro and cross-hw repeat (24h)
- Kai: kernel/softmax analysis (48h)
- Rina: canary deployment + alerting (24h)

deploy-bot: Canary with profile `structured-punct-prefer-fp16` deployed to pool-punct (4 nodes) at 2025-11-05T11:08:10Z :rocket:

Rina Patel: monitoring set: alert if JSON-schema-failures > 0.4% in 15m window

Hector Alvarez: one more ask: add a small inline validator that checks for leading/trailing braces and quoted keys; if fail, re-run with fp16 automatically.

Iris Gomez: noted, prototyping now and will push to canary. Posting updates here. Thanks!
